from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path('/tmp/stele-ci-test-profile')
OUT = Path('/tmp/stele-test-profile-pair-b638390')
assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12)
def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def ns(value):
    return int(Decimal(value) * 1_000_000_000)
head = command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
tree = command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}')
assert head.startswith('b638390') and not command('git', 'status', '--porcelain')
assert not any(k.startswith('CARGO_PROFILE_') or k in ('RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS') for k in os.environ)
names = sorted([
    'matches_reference_all_kinds_maximum_shapes_and_extension_fields',
    'matches_reference_msb_coordinates_and_nonboolean_validity',
    'accepts_signed_rows_and_excludes_padding_with_a_separate_selector',
    'rejects_wrong_point_dimension_before_evaluation',
])
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
receipt = dict(head=head, tree=tree, python=sys.version.split()[0],
               rustc=command('rustc', '-vV'), cargo=command('cargo', '-V'),
               device=command('sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string'),
               host=platform.platform(), started_at=now(), measurements=[],
               script=dict(path=__file__, sha256=digest(__file__)),
               sources={p: digest(ROOT / p) for p in [
                   'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml',
                   'crates/stele-cqis/tests/table_mle.rs',
                   'crates/stele-cqis/tests/support/table_mle.rs']}, complete=False)
def save():
    temp = OUT / 'receipt.tmp'
    temp.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    temp.replace(OUT / 'receipt.json')
save()
for level in (0, 2):
    assert command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == head
    assert not command('git', 'status', '--porcelain')
    target = OUT / f'target-opt{level}'
    assert not target.exists()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    settings = {'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': str(target), 'CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL': str(level),
                'CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS': 'true', 'CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OVERFLOW_CHECKS': 'true'}
    env.update(settings)
    args = ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'stele-cqis', '--test', 'table_mle', '--all-features', '--locked', '--offline', '--verbose']
    log = OUT / f'opt{level}.log'
    started = now()
    load_before = [str(v) for v in os.getloadavg()]
    print(f'{started} start opt{level}', flush=True)
    begin = time.perf_counter_ns()
    with log.open('xb') as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter_ns() - begin
    raw = log.read_text()
    item = dict(opt_level=level, command=args, env=settings, started_at=started,
                ended_at=now(), wall_ns=elapsed, load_before=load_before,
                load_after=[str(v) for v in os.getloadavg()], exit_code=result.returncode,
                log=dict(path=str(log), sha256=digest(log)))
    receipt['measurements'].append(item)
    save()
    assert result.returncode == 0, item
    actual_names = sorted(re.findall(r'^test ([a-z_]+) \.\.\. ok$', raw, re.M))
    assert actual_names == names, actual_names
    timing = re.findall(r'test result: ok\. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in ([0-9.]+)s', raw)
    compile_time = re.findall(r'Finished `test` profile \[[^\]]+\] target\(s\) in ([0-9.]+)s', raw)
    assert len(timing) == len(compile_time) == 1
    invocations = [line for line in raw.splitlines() if 'Running `' in line and '--crate-name ' in line]
    assert any('--crate-name table_mle ' in line and '--test ' in line for line in invocations)
    assert any('--crate-name stele_cqis ' in line for line in invocations)
    assert any('--crate-name stele_field ' in line for line in invocations)
    if level:
        assert all('-C opt-level=2' in line and '-C debug-assertions=on' in line for line in invocations)
    else:
        assert all('-C opt-level=' not in line and '-C debug-assertions=off' not in line for line in invocations)
    assert all('-C overflow-checks=off' not in line for line in invocations)
    binaries = [p for p in (target / 'debug/deps').glob('table_mle-*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix != '.d' and os.access(p, os.X_OK)]
    assert len(binaries) == 1
    item.update(test_names=actual_names, compile_reported_ns=ns(compile_time[0]),
                execution_reported_ns=ns(timing[0]), rustc_invocations=invocations,
                binary=dict(path=str(binaries[0]), sha256=digest(binaries[0])))
    save()
    print(json.dumps({k: item[k] for k in ('opt_level', 'wall_ns', 'compile_reported_ns', 'execution_reported_ns', 'exit_code')}), flush=True)
assert command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == head and not command('git', 'status', '--porcelain')
assert all(digest(ROOT / p) == h for p, h in receipt['sources'].items())
receipt.update(complete=True, ended_at=now())
save()
print(f'complete {OUT}/receipt.json', flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/tmp/stele-ci-test-profile')
OUT = Path('/tmp/stele-test-profile-pair-b638390')
assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12)
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
receipt = json.loads((OUT / 'receipt.json').read_text())
assert receipt['head'] == git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') and not git('status', '--porcelain')
assert len(receipt['measurements']) == 2
assert digest(receipt['script']['path']) == receipt['script']['sha256']
receipt['original_driver_outcome'] = 'Both cargo test processes exited 0; postprocessing wrongly required build-time dependencies to use opt2. This verification limits that assertion to the actual test, CQIS and field crates. No test was rerun.'
receipt['original_receipt'] = dict(path=str(OUT / 'receipt.json'), sha256=digest(OUT / 'receipt.json'))
probe = OUT / 'checks.rs'
probe.write_text('''fn main() {
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|_| {}));
    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| debug_assert!(std::hint::black_box(false))).is_err());
    let n: u8 = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("input").parse().expect("u8");
    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| std::hint::black_box(n) + 1).is_err());
    println!("PASS debug assertion and runtime overflow checks");
}
''')
for item in receipt['measurements']:
    level = item['opt_level']
    assert item['exit_code'] == 0 and digest(item['log']['path']) == item['log']['sha256']
    raw = Path(item['log']['path']).read_text()
    names = sorted(re.findall(r'^test ([a-z_]+) \.\.\. ok$', raw, re.M))
    assert len(names) == 4 and names == receipt['measurements'][0]['test_names']
    times = re.findall(r'test result: ok\. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in ([0-9.]+)s', raw)
    compilation = re.findall(r'Finished `test` profile \[[^\]]+\] target\(s\) in ([0-9.]+)s', raw)
    assert len(times) == len(compilation) == 1
    invocations = [line for line in raw.splitlines() if 'Running `' in line and any(f'--crate-name {name} ' in line for name in ('table_mle', 'stele_cqis', 'stele_field'))]
    assert len(invocations) == 3
    assert all('-C overflow-checks=off' not in line and '-C debug-assertions=off' not in line for line in invocations)
    assert all(('-C opt-level=2' in line and '-C debug-assertions=on' in line) if level == 2 else '-C opt-level=' not in line for line in invocations)
    target = Path(item['env']['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])
    binaries = [p for p in (target / 'debug/deps').glob('table_mle-*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix != '.d' and os.access(p, os.X_OK)]
    assert len(binaries) == 1
    binary_sha = digest(binaries[0])
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(item['env'])
    args = item['command'] + ['--no-run', '--message-format=json']
    metadata = OUT / f'opt{level}-artifacts.jsonl'
    stderr = OUT / f'opt{level}-artifacts.stderr'
    with metadata.open('xb') as stdout, stderr.open('xb') as err:
        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=err)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and digest(binaries[0]) == binary_sha
    records = [json.loads(line) for line in metadata.read_text().splitlines()]
    artifacts = [r for r in records if r['reason'] == 'compiler-artifact']
    assert artifacts and all(r['fresh'] for r in artifacts)
    relevant = [r for r in artifacts if r['target']['name'] in ('table_mle', 'stele-cqis', 'stele_cqis', 'stele-field', 'stele_field')]
    assert len(relevant) == 3
    assert all(r['profile']['opt_level'] == str(level) and r['profile']['debug_assertions'] is True and r['profile']['overflow_checks'] is True for r in relevant)
    executable = OUT / f'checks-opt{level}'
    # Match the actual commands: overflow checking follows enabled debug assertions.
    flags = ['-C', 'opt-level=2', '-C', 'debug-assertions=on'] if level else []
    compile_args = ['rustc', '--edition=2021', str(probe), '-o', str(executable), *flags]
    result = subprocess.run(compile_args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    run = subprocess.run([str(executable), '255'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert run.returncode == 0 and run.stdout.strip() == 'PASS debug assertion and runtime overflow checks' and not run.stderr
    item.update(test_names=names, compile_reported_ns=int(Decimal(compilation[0])*1_000_000_000),
                execution_reported_ns=int(Decimal(times[0])*1_000_000_000), rustc_invocations=invocations,
                binary=dict(path=str(binaries[0]), sha256=binary_sha),
                cargo_artifacts=dict(command=args, path=str(metadata), sha256=digest(metadata),
                    stderr_path=str(stderr), stderr_sha256=digest(stderr), all_fresh=True,
                    relevant_profiles=[dict(target=r['target']['name'], profile=r['profile']) for r in relevant]),
                runtime_checks=dict(source=str(probe), source_sha256=digest(probe), compile_command=compile_args,
                    binary_sha256=digest(executable), command=[str(executable), '255'], exit_code=run.returncode, stdout=run.stdout))
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == receipt['head'] and not git('status', '--porcelain')
assert all(digest(ROOT / p) == h for p, h in receipt['sources'].items())
receipt.update(complete=True, verified_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               verification_script=dict(path=__file__, sha256=digest(__file__)))
path = OUT / 'verified-receipt.json'
with path.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(receipt, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(path), sha256=digest(path), complete=True,
    measurements=[{k: row[k] for k in ('opt_level', 'wall_ns', 'compile_reported_ns', 'execution_reported_ns')} for row in receipt['measurements']])))
